text:
Maya Li: Heads-up — launching the Q2 hybrid search + retarget campaign tomorrow 9am PT. Plan = staggered creative refresh across geos, 3 ad groups per geo, 48h hold to pause if CPA > 3x baseline. Need tracking + lead routing check before go.

Jonah Park: SGTM. Who's owning UTM mapping and the webhook to Marketo? Also propose a soft-launch at 25% budget for the first 6h.

Samir Gupta: I can own the webhook. Pulling baseline CPA by geo now. Will set tracking to a 7-day conv window unless you want different.

Lina Torres: Creative refresh ready — A/B/C variants (static hero + new headline set). My suggestion: rotate A for first 12h, then B/C like a staggered roll. Keep search headlines focused on "Redwood Inference" + "predictable latency".

Maya Li: Perfect. Jonah — can you put pacing rules: start 25% -> 50% at 3h -> full at 12h if CPA <= 1.8x baseline? If not, hold at 50% and notify.

Jonah Park: On it. Updating bidding script now. Adding automated rule: pause ad group if CTR < 0.5% AND CPA > 2x baseline after min 200 clicks. Will log any pauses into #marketing-alerts.

Aditya R.: @Samir confirm the webhook endpoint and payload schema? Need lead payload to include campaign_id, utm_source, utm_medium, creative_variant, and timestamp for routing into the webinar flow.

Samir Gupta: Webhook endpoint: https://hooks.redwood.ai/marketing/lead. Payload sample I'm pushing to staging now:
```
{
  "campaign_id": "Q2-HYBRID-001",
  "email": "foo@example.com",
  "utm_campaign": "q2_hybrid_launch",
  "creative_variant": "A",
  "lead_score": 42
}
```
I'll also add a test payload to confirm Marketo mapping.

Maya Li: :thumbsup: Also need landing page to pass creative_variant into Marketo + webinar registration form hidden field. Lina — can you add that in staging?

Lina Torres: Done in staging. Added hidden field `creative_variant` to the form, GA event `creative_variant`, and a dataLayer push on submit. Tested in Chrome and Safari.

Maya Li: Quick timezone check — we scheduled 9am PT, that should be 16:00Z. Campaign-bot, confirm scheduled time.

campaign-bot: Campaign "Q2 Hybrid Search + Retarget" scheduled by Maya Li for 2026-04-02 16:00:00 UTC. Auto-pacing rules and pause thresholds attached.

Jonah Park: I'll monitor the first 6h and post a snapshot into #marketing-report every 2h. Want anyone on watch for live edits?

Maya Li: Samir + Lina — please be on standby for tracking or landing tweaks. I'll join the 10am PT stand to review first-hour metrics and approve full ramp.

Lina Torres: One more note — creative C has the punctuation variant (shorter headline) and past AU tests showed +8% CTR. Might bias allocation slightly higher for AU geo on first rotation.

Maya Li: Good call. Let's bias CA/US/EU evenly but give AU +15% weight on variant C for the first 24h.

Samir Gupta: Test payload sent to staging endpoint and confirmed 200 from Marketo mapping. All good to go.

Jonah Park: Budget rules set. Soft-launch scheduled. Will push updates into thread during the ramp.

Maya Li: Great work team — let's keep the channel clear for any urgent pauses. :rocket:
